overview.description: The wizard inputs are fed to Claude, which generates copy and design specs. Those AI outputs are then passed through section-builder functions that produce valid GHL page-data JSON (pd.sections). Each page is injected directly into GHL Firebase Storage by the Chrome extension.
pipeline: 1. Wizard inputs → buildCoachContext() → shared context block
2. Context block → Claude (Group 1: Sonnet, Groups 2+3: Haiku) → JSON copy + design spec
3. AI copy + design spec → buildAllPageData() → 4 GHL page-data objects
4. Chrome extension reads existing Firebase payload, swaps pd.sections, writes back

colourSchemes.description: 5 fixed palettes. Claude's design spec can fine-tune individual hex values; the selected palette provides the fallback for every colour token.

landing.description: The main challenge landing page. Built from 5 independently-varied section blocks + a fixed footer. Claude picks layout variants for each section based on the coach's context.

variants.description: Left column: badge + H1 + subheadline + bullet list + CTA button. Right column: countdown label + countdown timer + video embed placeholder.
variants.bestFor: Coaches who have or can record an intro video. Highest-converting hero.

variants.description: Full-width centred layout. Badge + H1 + subheadline + bullet list + CTA button, all centred in a single column, max-width 720px.
variants.bestFor: Bold single-hook offers. Clean and premium.

variants.description: Left column: badge + H1 + subheadline + bullet list + CTA. Right column: image placeholder (replace with coach/result photo).
variants.bestFor: No video available — strong coach or result photo.

variants.description: Left column: badge + H1 + subheadline + CTA. Right column: urgency label + countdown timer + spots note. No bullet list — urgency does the work.
variants.bestFor: Cohort challenges with a real deadline.

variants.description: Full-width centred layout. Badge + H1 + subheadline + bullet list + CTA. Max-width 900px headline, wider than hero-centered. Designed for large background imagery.

socialProof.note: Omitted if the final-cta variant is 'cta-social-proof-cta' (it already includes proof in the CTA section).

variants.description: Three columns separated by vertical dividers. Left: star rating + member count. Centre: AI core-promise snippet. Right: 'Free to join — no card required'.
variants.bestFor: Coaches with strong testimonial language. Default.

variants.description: One dominant number ('500+') centred large in primary colour, with a supporting label beneath.
variants.bestFor: When one stat dominates all others.

variants.description: Three equal-width columns, each with a large coloured number and a short descriptor. '500+ Coaches Launched', '4.9★ Average Rating', '100% Free to Join'.
Large open-quote glyph + AI corePromise text as a centred italic quote + attribution line.
variants.bestFor: High-trust personal brands with a single killer quote.

variants.description: Same three-column badge layout as stars-bullets but without dividers — wider column gutters, bolder text weights.
variants.bestFor: Coaches with credentials, press mentions, or certification logos.

whatsIncluded.note: All AI variant names route to the single-col layout. Multi-column variants were removed — they caused GHL publish timeouts at 121KB / 63 total elements.

variants.description: Eyebrow label + H2 heading + a single c-bullet-list of up to 6 benefit bullet points. Light background (scheme alt colour).
variants.bestFor: All cases. Consolidated from 5 AI-suggested variants to stay within GHL's element-count limit.

faq.note: Omitted entirely if the AI returns no faqItems. All AI variant names route to faq-single-col. Other variants are defined in code for future use but not dispatched.

variants.description: H2 heading + up to 3 FAQ items rendered as plain paragraphs (bold question + muted answer). Light background. 9 elements total.
variants.bestFor: All cases. Native c-faq accordion was removed — it caused GHL publish hangs.

variants.description: Full-width heading row + FAQ items in a single column below. (Currently routes to faq-single-col in production.)
35% image column left, 65% FAQ column right. (Currently routes to faq-single-col in production.)
Single-col FAQ with numbered items. (Currently routes to faq-single-col in production.)
Single-col FAQ followed by a CTA button inside the section. (Currently routes to faq-single-col in production.)
H2 + urgency paragraph + CTA button, all centred on the scheme's primary-colour background.
Left column: H2 + subheadline. Right column: CTA button + trust micro-copy ('Free · No credit card'). Primary colour background.
variants.bestFor: Cleaner close — puts the CTA on the right where the eye lands last.

variants.description: H2 + urgency sub + countdown timer + CTA button, all centred on primary colour background.
variants.bestFor: Cohort challenges with a real deadline.

variants.description: Eyebrow label ('One last thing') + large H2 + CTA button on scheme dark background. No urgency text — minimal and confident.
variants.bestFor: Premium / high-ticket offers where urgency would feel cheap.

variants.description: Star rating line + H2 + urgency paragraph + CTA button, all centred. When selected, the standalone social-proof section above is skipped.
variants.bestFor: When you want social proof right at the close.

footer.description: Fixed. Copyright year + 'Privacy Policy | Terms of Service' + results disclaimer. Dark background (scheme dark colour). Not variant-selectable.

optin.description: Single fixed layout. Converts the landing page visitor into a lead. A GHL form element is dropped here — the coach connects it to their pipeline in GHL after import.

sections.name: Hero / Form section
sections.description: Step badge ('Step 1 of 2') + H1 (first sentence of AI formIntroText, ≤80 chars) + full intro paragraph + GHL form element placeholder + trust micro-copy ('Secure · No credit card · Cancel anytime'). Gradient dark background.

sections.name: Footer
sections.description: Same fixed footer as landing page.

thankYou.description: Shown after opt-in. Confirms registration, walks the lead through next steps, and drives them toward booking a strategy call.

sections.name: Hero
sections.description: Celebration badge ('🎉 You're in!') + H1 (AI confirmationMessage) + sub-paragraph (AI bookingEncouragement). Gradient dark background.

sections.name: Next Steps
sections.description: Eyebrow label + H2 + up to 3 numbered step cards, each rendered as a styled paragraph with light background and rounded corners.

sections.name: Booking CTA
sections.description: H2 ('One more step — book your kick-off call') + sub-paragraph + CTA button ('Book My Free Call →'). Gradient of primary → accent colours.

booking.description: Strategy call booking page. Left column holds AI-generated 'why book' copy; right column has a calendar placeholder the coach replaces with their GHL Calendar element.

sections.name: Hero
sections.description: Badge ('Almost there — pick a time') + H1 (first sentence of AI shortIntro, ≤80 chars) + AI shortIntro full paragraph. Gradient dark background.

sections.name: Two-Column Content
sections.description: Left (50%): 'Why Book' eyebrow + AI whyBook bullet points (✓ prefix) + expectation label + AI expectationSetting text + divider + 3 trust lines ('Free 30-min call', 'No sales pressure', '100% confidential'). Right (50%): 'Select a Date & Time' H3 + setup note + calendar placeholder paragraph + CTA button + micro-copy.

sections.name: Trust Bar
sections.description: Three equal columns: 'Free 30-min call', 'No sales pressure', '100% confidential'. Dark background. Slim padding.

nativeGhlElementsUsed.description: H1–H3 headings with desktop + mobile font sizes
Countdown timer set to 7 days from generation time
